_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard. A Symbian project is a DEVICE - one ROM image, which says which phone it is and carries the phone's own filesystem - and, if the project wants one, a package installed onto it before it runs.

slots.title: Device ROM
slots.help: A Symbian phone's ROM image (the file EKA2L1 calls SYM.ROM). It says which device it is - manufacturer, model, firmware code and Symbian version - and it carries drive Z, so nothing else is needed.

slots.title: Package
slots.help: A Symbian installation package (.sis or .sisx) installed onto drive C before the machine starts. What it writes lives in the machine's memory, so it is part of every savestate and every movie made from this project.
